tasks: Upload universal, ARM64, and ARMv7 APK artifacts
implementation: WorkManager schedules a 12-hour Live TV guide refresh with a 2-hour flex window when the active profile has enabled sources.
Periodic work requires a connected network and storage that is not low; failed source imports are retried exponentially only when all enabled sources fail.
Imports are sequential, profile-scoped, and preserve cached guides when an individual source fails; manual refresh remains available.
The worker obtains the existing refresh job through a Hilt entry point without adding a WorkManager-specific Hilt dependency.
unitTestEvidence: Selected JVM tests passed, including LiveTvGuideRefreshJobTest for enabled-source filtering, partial failure retention, and the empty-source case, plus LiveTvViewModelTest scheduler reconciliation.
instrumentationEvidence: The Android instrumentation source set compiled; instrumented tests were not executed.
limitations: Debug APKs signed with the CI debug key; not a production release.
Instrumented tests compiled but were not executed on hardware.
No Android TV Box was connected through ADB for physical QA.
